records.reason: Preserve the mapped independent-event and disjoint-addition targets under the ordinary independent dart-throw convention. The actual labeled image has one odd inner sector and two odd outer sectors. Each inner sector has area 3*pi and each annular sector 9*pi, so odd-score area is 21*pi out of 36*pi and P(odd)=7/12. An odd two-dart sum requires the disjoint odd-even or even-odd outcomes, giving 2*(7/12)*(5/12)=35/72, source B. The statement explicitly supplies area-proportional marginal probabilities, so no additional probability-to-area theorem is needed to justify that given rule. The joint model still uses independent throws; retain that honest ordinary-convention qualification without promoting it to a confirmed defect or pretending the six regions are equally likely.

changes.rationale: Preserve the already root-approved H finite-constraint-deduction target with translation support. The actual tile labels in top/right/bottom/left order are I=(8,9,7,3), II=(6,3,2,4), III=(7,5,0,1), IV=(2,1,6,9). Translation fixes these orientations. Horizontal matches are II->I, I->IV and IV->III, and the only two disjoint pairs using all four tiles are (II,I) and (IV,III). Vertical matching forces (II,I) above (IV,III), since II's bottom 2 matches IV's top 2 and I's bottom 7 matches III's top 7; the reverse arrangement fails. Thus C receives IV, source D. Exact h235 covers counting ordered selections by permutations, not uniquely satisfying four edge-label constraints. Exact finite-constraint deduction already covers the actual task; the frozen new-node suggestion is obsolete, and neither a new placement synthesis node nor a forced permutation procedure is needed.

records.reason: Preserve inverse proportion and graph-reading targets for the relationship between trip speed and total duration, with speed*time=distance support. If M travels at speed v for duration T, then N's stated speed 2*v and equal distance force duration T/2. Of the actual five choice images only D has twice the height and half the horizontal extent, so source D is correct. The other images show respectively equal duration, double duration, half speed with equal duration, and half speed with double duration. The constant speed-time segments themselves are horizontal; the inverse proportion is between the two trips' speed and duration, not the plotted speed as a function of running time. The stem's dashed-versus-thin-solid mismatch is visible but harmless because M and N are explicitly labeled. Retain that qualification and normal grading.
